verdict: Paid campaigns have been dark 12 days; organic activity is holding on.
narrative: All Meta advertising stopped on August 6th, leaving 12 consecutive days without paid activity — the 45 leads and $1,171.64 in spend this period were earned before that date. Organic signals are softening in parallel: Google Business Profile engagement is down 23% this week and Instagram reach has nearly disappeared. Website traffic did spike mid-week despite zero paid activity, pointing to residual branded interest that is keeping some visibility alive. Separately, the CRM shows 33 contacts logged against those 45 leads, but no appointments or opportunities were created from them — that intake gap is being addressed now, independent of the ad pause. Campaigns are being reviewed for reactivation, and the contact-to-opportunity workflow is being corrected so that when leads resume, none fall through.
